definition: The Sparkles emoji (U+2728 ✨ SPARKLES) is an emoji that has one large star surrounded by smaller stars.
details: Originating from Japan to represent sparkles used in anime and manga, the sparkles are often used as emphasis in text by surrounding words or phrases with it. It is the third most-used emoji in the world on Twitter as of 2021. Since the mid 2020s it has been used by major software companies to represent artificial intelligence, marketing the technology as "like magic".

explainer.lead: The Sparkles emoji (U+2728 ✨) shows one large star surrounded by smaller stars. It matters as a cultural signal: since the mid 2020s major software companies use it to mean artificial intelligence, marketing the technology as "like magic".

tiers.eli5: It is the little twinkle-star you see in text, originally borrowed from Japanese comics to show something shining—now companies stick it on AI features to make them feel magical.
tiers.practitioner: Teams placing ✨ next to a feature label should know it reads as an AI claim to users, so it should not be used decoratively on non-AI features.
tiers.paperLevel: A Unicode emoji at code point U+2728 named SPARKLES; it was the third most-used emoji worldwide on Twitter as of 2021.

explainer.example: A product marks its new auto-summarise button "Summarise ✨" to signal AI, while leaving the plain save button unmarked.
